{{Top|leg}}
'''Digit Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] unit that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] consisted of five [[IR-3F-class light frigate/Legends|IR-3F Patrol Craft]] and it fought against the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] during the Imperium's [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions|attempted invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Three of the five [[Starship/Legends|ships]] survived the battle, and they eventually entered the service of the Bakuran government.
